log.msg: Cause: not the stitching. Dictate.close_segment cuts audio and sends each segment once (commit joins whole finals, no overlap). In session v-xhx7fmx line 34 the raw is one long ~30 s reply where Whisper looped and repeated its last 44 words; the whisper bucket no longer holds that run (rotated), so line 34 itself is the evidence. Fix: safety net collapse_tail in ux/Dictate/repeat.js called from ComposerMic.collapse_repeat; proof test/repeat.mjs 5/5 ok, order.mjs and flicker.mjs ok on port 52330.

findings.text: The new module file `ux/Dictate/repeat.js` is not indexed where every dictation piece is listed: `ux/Dictate/doc/map.md` (the "map of every dictation piece", rows near :101 for Mic.js) has no row for it, and `ux/Dictate/files.jsonl` has no `repeat.js` row. Add a map row ("collapse_tail: drops a 5+ word repeated tail; called by ComposerMic.collapse_repeat").

The new doc section in `ext/Chat/doc/mic-notes.md:366` is appended directly under the dangling "## Settings: clean / KILL SWITCH (…):" line, so it reads as the kill switch's content. Place it under its own heading away from that line (or before "## Settings"), and check that the readme's anchor `#whisper-repeats-collapse_repeat` resolves.

A one-word repeat of 10+ is still halved: `collapse_tail("Yes. Yes. … Yes.")` (10×) returns 5 "Yes." — a 5-word window of the same word matches itself. The brief says never touch a real repeat; skipping a tail whose words are all the same (period 1–2) would close it. Rare in speech, so a note.

Brief step 4 asked to feed the cases "through `collapse_repeat`"; `test/repeat.mjs` calls `collapse_tail` only, so the whole-doubling branch in `Mic.js:636` and the `t === w.join(" ") ? text : t` join are untested. Mic.js's absolute `/framework/` imports likely stop node from loading it; say so in the test header if that is why.
The case label "a whole doubling (6 words)" in `test/repeat.mjs:7` is two 5-word halves; rename it.

Brief step 4 named the readme's proof list (`ux/Dictate/readme.md:9`); the change added a separate bold line at :12 instead. It is findable, so fine, but the "Proofs" line now misses `test/repeat.mjs`.

The cause line in `session.jsonl` gives no line numbers for the stitching check ("Dictate.close_segment … commit joins whole finals") and the bucket run had rotated, so the "not the stitching" verdict rests on reading the code; a `Dictate.js:<line>` reference would let a fresh agent verify it in one step. The message to `mastermind-dictation-2` (step 6) is not recorded anywhere in the folder.

Simpler alternative: the 15-line `collapse_tail` could live as a second static in `ComposerMic` beside `collapse_repeat` (the fence named Mic.js, not a new `ux/Dictate/repeat.js`); the separate file does buy a node-testable pure function, which is a fair trade.
